editorial.blurb: Erick Williams' intimate tequila and mezcal bar delivers excellent cocktails and thoughtfully crafted Mexican fare in a beautifully decorated space with killer vibes.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the all-day Sunday happy hour for an unbeatable vibe, and don't miss the Daydreamer cocktail—reviewers say it's a must-try that pairs perfectly with the aguachiles.
